# Tesla is recalling 20,000 vehicles over headlights that are too bright for oncoming drivers

The NHTSA says the low-beam headlights on certain Model 3 and Model Y vehicles may reduce visibility for oncoming drivers and raise crash risk

## Tesla recalls Model 3 and Model Y

Tesla is recalling 20,349 2017-2023 Model 3 and 2020-2023 Model Y vehicles. The headlight low beams may be too bright and exceed the maximum light output.

The remedy is currently under development. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed Sept. 15, 2026. Owners may contact Tesla customer service at 1-877-798-3752. Tesla's number for this recall is SB-24-17-003.
